value.title: Eroi dei cieli (1)
value.synopsis: Luna Girl steals an old tea service from the museum, but the PJ Masks follow her.

value.title: Heroes of the Sky (2)
value.synopsis: Catboy and Gekko do everything they can to help Owlette find her memories.

value.title: Heroes of the Sky (3)
value.synopsis: When they give up on her after trying so hard, they end up teaming up with Luna Girl to stop Romeo.

value.title: Heroes of the Sky (4)
value.synopsis: The PJ Masks learn that the heart of being a hero is being a good friend.

value.title: Chi ha fatto entrare le falene?
value.synopsis: The moths infiltrate HQ, and Gekko won't admit that he let them in until it is too late.

value.title: Comandante Miao
value.synopsis: Catboy realizes that a true Cat Explorer puts his team before the discovery.

value.title: La sorella smarrita di Motsuki
value.synopsis: The PJs offer to help Motsuki find Luna, but miss Night Ninja in the process.

value.title: Non così Ninja
value.synopsis: When the Ninjalinos lose their ninja powers, the PJ Masks teach them alternative skills.

value.title: La montagna delle feste dei PJ
value.synopsis: The PJ Masks are enticed by a fake An Yu to break all the rules and have a party on Mystery Mountain.

value.title: Lupetti della pagoda
value.synopsis: An Yu cerca di addomesticare i Lupetti selvaggi.

value.title: Il segreto del Maestro Feng
value.synopsis: Armadylan and Catboy compete over an exclusive Master Fang comic, thinking it contains a hero secret.

value.title: Aerodylan
value.synopsis: Armadylan loses the PJs' special jet to Night Ninja.

value.title: Indicenti di asteroidi
value.synopsis: Owlette causes an asteroid accident. While trying to make it right, the PJ Masks meet another night-time hero, Newton!

value.title: Tutto sugli asteroidi
value.synopsis: Newton likes the PJ Masks... but also likes his solitude.

value.title: La macchina spaziale di Romeo
value.synopsis: Newton learns that he's not just brains.

value.title: Newton e i Ninja
value.synopsis: Newton swears off fighting villains.

value.title: L'asteroide scomparso
value.synopsis: Newton thinks Owlette stole a precious asteroid - but she's been framed by Romeo.

value.title: La fabbrica volante fuori controllo
value.synopsis: Romeo needs the PJs' help bringing his Flying Factory under control, but they don't trust him.

value.title: Munki-gu
value.synopsis: Gekko tries to train a naughty monkey.

value.title: Munki-gu in città
value.synopsis: Munki-gu sabotages the PJ Masks' mission with pranks.

value.title: Munki-gu in missione
value.synopsis: Catboy enlists Munki-gu to go aboard the Flying Factory to distract Romeo.

value.title: La leggenda dell'osso dei lupetti
value.synopsis: Kevin doesn't think he'll ever be top dog; he's not wolfy enough to find the legendary bone.

value.title: Geko contro Malvadilan
value.synopsis: Gekko recruits Armadylan for extra training.

value.title: Super Super Gattovelocità
value.synopsis: Catboy wants to increase his speed.

value.title: Il drago di Munki-gu
value.synopsis: Munki-gu enchants a dragon float, turning it into a menace.
